title: Universal homogeneous two-sorted ultrametric spaces
summary: We view ultrametric spaces as two-sorted structures consisting of a set of points and of a linearly ordered set of distances. We call the appropriate notion of embeddings distance-carrying (dc for short). Those are obtained by combining isometries and linear order embeddings. We show that the class of all finite two-sorted ultrametric spaces with dc-embeddings is Fraïssé, and that the limit is the countable rational Urysohn ultrametric space $\mathbb{U}$.
